verdict.rationale: Sketch documents an official JavaScript API with a browsable reference of classes and methods. Its developer site also offers a 'try it now' sample that you run inside the Sketch Mac app, so examples are runnable, but only within the desktop app rather than in an interactive in-browser reference. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec for a web API explorer. Missing for 10: an interactive in-docs API explorer or playground, runnable examples across the reference rather than a single hello-world snippet, and independent corroboration of the reference's interactivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
